resources.string: WITH US helps deaf and hard-of-hearing people follow social media videos: it reads the on-screen captions and shows them in sign language in a floating window above any app. Everything is processed on your phone, and the app has no internet permission.
Service is off. Follow the steps below.

1. Tap "Open accessibility settings" and turn on the "وصلة-WITHUS" service.

2. If the option is greyed out: tap "App info", then the ⋮ menu at the top, then "Allow restricted settings". Then repeat step 1.

3. Open any video and turn on captions (CC). A floating window with the avatar appears and signs the words. Drag it with one finger and pinch with two fingers to resize. Tap the avatar to show the − + ⏩ ↔ — buttons: ⏩ cycles the speed (×1, ×1.5, ×2), ↔ switches the dominant hand (right/left), and — folds it into a small icon.
Privacy: the app has no internet permission, so nothing leaves your phone. It scans on-screen text only to find captions and does not store it.
If captions are not read in a particular app, tap \"Refresh diagnostics\" while a video plays, then \"Copy diagnostics\" and send the text to the app developer.
